purpose: Teach: フェルナンド/クルス/ヴェルディ/サダム/リヨン/スコープ/アグリ/ドーン

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがスペインのフェルナンド王の歴史を研究された
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, your father studied the history of King Ferdinand of Spain.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic. Opens gently on the memory. Measured pace, slight reverence for the detail. Voice trails down at the end, as if placing the thought carefully into time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、映画女優のペネロペ・クルスを愛されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and when you were young, you loved that actress Penelope Cruz, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful, teasing lilt. Warm conspiratorial tone. Quick delivery with a knowing smile underneath. Rises slightly on the final tag question, inviting his reaction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがヴェルディのオペラ全集を蔵書された
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, your father collected the complete operas of Verdi.
lines.style: Gentle, reflective. Slight pause before the detail lands. Quiet admiration in the voice. Slows on 'Verdi' — the weight of that collection. Soft fade at the close.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、サダム政権のニュースを観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you used to watch the news about the Saddam regime, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Light, teasing. Almost sing-song in its playfulness. She's enjoying catching him in his own contradictions. Warm amusement, not unkind. Quick tail at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがフランスのリヨン市に出張された
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, your father had a business trip to Lyon, France.
lines.style: Quiet, specific. Voice settles on the place-name as if seeing it. Paced evenly, almost like reading from an old letter. Tender underneath — these are the fragments he holds onto.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、望遠スコープで星空観察されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, and when you were young, you observed the stars through a telescope, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Bright, knowing. A gentle poke at him. She's delighted to have caught another one. Warm and quick, like she's been waiting to land this particular point. Affectionate edge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんがアグリビジネスに早くから注目された
lines.en: When you were young, Gran, your father was already paying attention to agribusiness.
lines.style: Measured, slightly more serious. Voice opens with respect. Slower tempo. There's admiration in this one — foresight, vision. Trails into quiet contemplation.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ホラー映画「ドーン・オブ・ザ・デッド」を観られたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And when you were young, you watched that horror film Dawn of the Dead, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Delighted, triumphant. Quick, almost giggling underneath. She's landed her final joke. Warm closing tease. Voice closes with affection and gentle victory.
